جَوْلَانٌ Dust; as also ↓ جَوْلٌ and ↓ جُولٌ , (K,) both mentioned by Az, (TA,) and ↓ جَيْلَانٌ , (K,) mentioned by ISd: [or] all signify dust which the wind makes to turn about or round about, to circle, or to revolve, upon, or from, the surface of the earth. (TA.) And Small pebbles which the wind makes to turn about or round about, to circle, or to revolve; (K, TA;) as also ↓ جَوْلٌ and ↓ جَيْلَانٌ . (TA.) ＝
-A2- جَوْلَانُ: see أَجْوَلُ.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
